mapper.select: SELECT a.auth_cd AS authrt_cd, /* 권한 코드 */ a.auth_nm AS authrt_nm, /* 권한 명 */ (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT usr_id) FROM cdm_own.usr WHERE auth_cd = a.auth_cd) AS authrt_user_cnt /* 권한사용자수 */ FROM cdm_own.auth a WHERE a.use_yn = 'Y' /* 사용 여부 */ ORDER BY a.sort_seq

SELECT (CASE WHEN b.prgrm_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS save_se_yn, /* 저장구분YN */ a.prgrm_id, /* 프로그램 ID */ a.prgrm_nm, /* 프로그램 명 */ #{authrtCd} AS authrt_cd, /* 권한 코드 */ a.http_mthd_nm AS http_method, /* http 메소드 */ a.url_addr_ptrn_cntn AS url_addr_ptrn, /* URL 주소 패턴 */ a.sort_seq AS sort_sn /* 정렬순서 */ FROM cdm_own.prgrm a /* 프로그램 */ LEFT JOIN cdm_own.prgrm_auth b ON a.prgrm_id = b.prgrm_id AND b.auth_cd = #{authrtCd} WHERE a.http_mthd_nm != 'common'
AND (a.prgrm_id LIKE '%' || #{prgrmIdOrNm} || '%' OR a.prgrm_nm LIKE '%' || #{prgrmIdOrNm} || '%') /* 프로그램 ID 또는 명 */
ORDER BY a.sort_seq, a.prgrm_id
